s.note: the lemon juice and heat that reveal the hidden map
s.how: Cut 600g chicken thighs into chunks and marinate in lemon juice, crushed garlic, oregano and olive oil for an hour. Grill until charred and cooked through. Spear on toothpicks and serve with mayonnaise mixed with lemon zest and juice.

Mix 500g flour, 7g yeast and 300ml warm water to a dough and rest an hour. Shape into figure eights, dip in boiling water with 2 tbsp bicarb soda and sprinkle with rock salt. Bake at 220C for 12 minutes, brush with butter and serve with yellow mustard.

m.how: Freeze a 600g rib eye steak for 30 minutes, then shave it paper thin. Fry 2 sliced onions in oil until soft, add the beef and sear fast on high heat. Lay provolone over the top to melt and pile into split long bread rolls.

w.note: Philadelphia street treat while the clues come together
w.how: Boil 750ml water with 250g sugar until dissolved and cool. Stir in 200ml lemon juice and the zest of 2 lemons. Freeze in a shallow tray, scraping and stirring with a fork every 40 minutes for 3 hours until smooth and icy, then scoop into cups.

d.note: the lemon juice that reveals the map
d.how: Dissolve 150g sugar in 150ml hot water and cool. Squeeze 6 lemons into a big jug and add the syrup with 1.5L cold water. Add sliced lemon, bruised mint and plenty of ice. Stir and pour into tall glasses while you search for clues.
